input.quote: ARTICLE IV TERM I Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the "Initial Period"). The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor. Upon any breach by Licensee of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation hereunder, the Licensor may immediately terminate this Agreement and prohibit the Licensee's use of any and/or all of the Licensed Technology.
input.rationale: The Agreement locks Licensee into a 36-month Initial Period (renewable for seven years at Licensor's option) with no right for Licensee to terminate for convenience anywhere in the document. The only termination triggers run in Licensor's favour (breach under Article IV and Article II, insolvency under Article XIX, Change of Control and wind-up under Article XX), and Article XXI/XXIII confirm Licensor retains all rights and payment entitlements on exit. Absence of any Customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months is a deviation under T4C (missing behaviour). Licensor has no convenience right on short notice, so only the Customer-side gap needs fixing. We added a 30-day Licensee convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, no early-termination charge or acceleration of Supplemental Payments, and express confirmation that Licensor may not terminate for convenience during the term.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; confirm Licensor has no convenience right during the term
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article IV commits us to a 36-month term with no ability to exit for convenience, while Licensor holds several unilateral termination triggers. We have added a Licensee right to terminate on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination charge or acceleration of Supplemental Payments, and confirmed Licensor has no convenience right during the term; if helpful we can move to 60-90 days' notice with a fee cap of no more than three months' fees.

ops.text: Termination for Convenience. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Licensee may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for convenience at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, without penalty, early termination charge, or acceleration of any user fees, Supplemental Payments or other amounts. Upon such termination, Licensor shall refund to Licensee any prepaid fees allocable to the period after the effective date of termination, and Licensee's sole payment obligation shall be for amounts accrued for use of the Licensed Technology through the effective date of termination. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any renewal or extension term.
